name: Charm of Cinders
description: Raise a burning wall ahead for four seconds.

name: Charm of Silence
description: Interrupt hazards and silence enemy abilities for three seconds.
source: Found at a Sequence gate or a rare elite.

name: Charm of Mirrors
description: Repeat your last ability cast at half damage.
source: Found at a Sequence gate or a rare elite.

name: Vial of Tallow
description: Drink the wax-warm tallow. Restore 35 vitality.

name: Charm of the Slow Gale
description: Every enemy moves at 40% speed for five seconds.

name: Mirror of Second Sight
description: Mark every enemy on screen and hold them still for one second.
